messages:
Mara: Heads-up — premerge eval gate tripped on the summarizer prompt-suite (v23). Regression: ~3.7% ROUGE-L drop and an uptick in hallucination cases (4/120). Staging canary failed the prompt set. Release window at 10:00 PT, need quick triage and decision.

Jonathan: On it. Is the regression only on the quantized runtime? Which exact model/version is running in canary right now? @deploy-bot can you post the deploy details?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy details: service=summarizer, model=summarizer-v3.2-quant, runtime=runtime-q8, promoted_at=1718498000. Perf: avg latency=185ms. Eval gate status=FAIL (delta ROUGE-L -3.7%).

Li: I reproduced locally — failures concentrate on long-context prompts (>=1024 tokens). Suspect recent attention kernel tweak (PR #4521) interacting with quantization. Rerunning preflight with kernel revert to confirm.

Mara: Ok — decision tree: (A) Pin canary back to v3.1 (fast), (B) Rollback canary entirely (cleaner), or (C) ship with mitigations (shorten max_input). Which should we choose for the 10:00 window?

Jonathan: Pinning seems fastest and least disruptive for the release window. We can open a bisect task to find the offending kernel change offline. I support pin for now.

Li: I opened a PR to pin canary to summarizer-v3.1: https://git.redwood/summarizer/PR-608. CI is green. If approved I can trigger the pin via deploy-bot.

Mara: @Jonathan can you review/approve the pin PR? Also @qa-runner can you run the targeted prompt subset against v3.1 to confirm the regressions disappear? :pray:

qa-runner: qa-runner: Started targeted eval run (subset 12 prompts focusing on long-context). ETA ~6m. I'll post results when complete.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Pin command syntax: `/deploy pin canary summarizer v3.1 --reason "eval-gate regression"` — running only after an approval message.

Jonathan: Reviewed and approved PR, running the pin now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary pinned: summarizer-v3.1 at 1718500500. Monitoring window: 15m. Rollback plan created: ROLLBACK-514 (runbook linked in PR comments).

qa-runner: qa-runner: Targeted eval results: v3.1 passes subset. ROUGE-L delta vs baseline +0.1%, no new hallucination cases in the subset. :white_check_mark:

Mara: Good. Plan: proceed with release window using pinned canary. Action items: Li to bisect kernel changes (assign PR-4521 bisect), Jonathan to watch production eval dashboards for 1h post-release, QA to expand prompt set to full 120 by EOD. Trigger ROLLBACK-514 if any metric drops >2% vs baseline.

Jonathan: I'll add a short note to release notes: "Canary pinned to summarizer-v3.1 due to premerge eval regression; follow-up bisect in progress." Also will set an alert rule for rouge_delta > 2%.

Li: Starting bisect now. I'll post updates in this thread. If I can reproduce a minimal repro I'll open a hotfix branch.

Mara: Thanks everyone. If anything changes ping here. :eyes:

(automated) deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Monitoring started for ROLLBACK-514. Will auto-trigger rollback command if configured alert thresholds are breached.
